WITH matched_labs AS (
    SELECT l.ID, p.SEX, l.PT, l.IGA, l.IGM,
           CASE WHEN l.IGA IS NOT NULL AND l.IGM IS NOT NULL THEN l.IGA - l.IGM END AS iga_igm_diff
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    INNER JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
), patient_averages AS (
    SELECT ID, SEX, AVG(PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(iga_igm_diff) AS avg_iga_igm_diff
    FROM matched_labs
    GROUP BY ID, SEX
), overall_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_iga_igm_diff) AS mean_patient_diff
    FROM patient_averages
), patient_ratios AS (
    SELECT pa.ID, pa.SEX, pa.avg_pt, pa.avg_iga_igm_diff,
           pa.avg_iga_igm_diff / NULLIF(om.mean_patient_diff, 0) AS ratio_to_overall_mean
    FROM patient_averages AS pa
    CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS om
), sex_summary AS (
    SELECT SEX, AVG(avg_pt) AS avg_pt,
           AVG(avg_iga_igm_diff) AS avg_iga_igm_diff,
           AVG(ratio_to_overall_mean) AS avg_ratio_to_overall_mean
    FROM patient_ratios
    GROUP BY SEX
)
SELECT 'patient' AS level, ID, SEX, avg_pt, avg_iga_igm_diff, ratio_to_overall_mean
FROM patient_ratios
UNION ALL
SELECT 'sex' AS level, NULL AS ID, SEX, avg_pt, avg_iga_igm_diff, avg_ratio_to_overall_mean
FROM sex_summary
